title: Avatar Intelligence: Amplifying Human Agency Through Persistent Personal Agents
title_zh: 化身智能：通过持久个人智能体放大人类能动性

paragraphs.en: 倡导化身智能范式,以持久个人智能体放大人类能动性,并提出智能体监督指数评估框架。 Personal AI agents are increasingly capable of handling long-horizon tasks across applications, yet users often need to invest substantial effort in specifying goals, resolving ambiguity, and verifying outcomes. We argue that progress should be measured by how effectively agents amplify human agency: enabling people to pursue their goals with less routine supervision while retaining control over consequential decisions. We advocate Avatar Intelligence, a paradigm of persistent personal agents that represent users' goals, values, and constraints through sustained decision delegation across contexts and time. We describe a maturity roadmap from human-directed execution to autonomous operation within delegated domains, and introduce the Agentic Oversight Index (AOI) as a framework for evaluating delivered value against agent-side operational cost and human oversight burden. We identify three core research challenges: identity-continuous personalization that carries user preferences across tasks, user-situated evolution through Rehearsal Engineering, and safety mechanisms that combine technical control with accountability and recourse. These directions define a research agenda for reliable decision delegation to personal agents across tasks and over time.
paragraphs.zh: 倡导化身智能范式，以持久个人智能体放大人类能动性，并提出智能体监督指数评估框架。个人智能体正日益能够跨应用处理长周期任务，但用户往往需要投入大量精力来设定目标、消除歧义并验证结果。 我们主张，进步应当以智能体放大人类能动性的有效程度来衡量：让人们能够在减少常规监督的情况下追求自己的目标，同时保留对重大决策的控制权。 我们倡导化身智能，这是一种持久个人智能体的范式，通过跨情境、跨时间的持续决策委托来代表用户的目标、价值观与约束。 我们描述了一条从人类主导执行到在委托领域内自主运行的成熟度路线图，并引入智能体监督指数（AOI）作为评估框架，用于衡量智能体所交付的价值与其自身运营成本和人类监督负担之间的关系。 我们识别出三项核心研究挑战：能够跨任务延续用户偏好的身份连续个性化、通过排演工程实现的用户情境化演化，以及将技术控制与问责和救济机制相结合的安全机制。 这些方向共同构成了一个研究议程，旨在实现跨任务、跨时间的对个人智能体的可靠决策委托。
